Embedding request with multiple inputs returns multiple embedding objects

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.embed_async(LiterLlm::EmbeddingRequest.new(input: ['Hello world', 'Goodbye world'], model: 'text-embedding-3-small'))
puts result.data.inspect
puts result.data[0].index.inspect
puts result.data[1].index.inspect
```
